note: 13 new cards made, 11 kept. Cost this run about $0.0034

cards.english_title: Middle School Students Report More Depression
cards.korean_desc: 2025년 우울감을 느꼈다는 중학생 비율이 26.2%로 고등학생의 25.1%보다 높았습니다. 중학생 비율이 고등학생보다 높은 것은 3년째입니다.
cards.english_desc: In 2025, 26.2 percent of middle school students said they had felt depressed, higher than the 25.1 percent of high school students. This was the third consecutive year that the middle school rate was higher.
cards.hook: Middle school feelings are taking the lead in an unexpected statistic.

cards.korean_title: 이 대통령, 세계 경제 선도국 강조
cards.english_title: Lee Highlights Korea’s Economic Strength
cards.korean_desc: 이재명 대통령은 한국이 세계 경제를 이끄는 국가로 떠올랐다고 말했습니다. 2분기 한국의 경상수지 흑자는 주요 경제국 중 세계 2위였습니다.
cards.english_desc: President Lee Jae Myung said South Korea has emerged as a country leading the global economy. In the second quarter, Korea had the world’s second-largest current account surplus among major economies.
cards.hook: Korea’s giant surplus is stepping onto the global podium.
cards.korean_hook: 한국의 큰 흑자가 세계 시상대에 올랐다

cards.english_title: Traditional Sparks Light Up Yeoju
cards.korean_desc: 경기도 여주에서 전통 낙화 행사가 열렸습니다. 불꽃이 매달린 꾸러미에서 폭포처럼 떨어지며 축제의 밤을 빛냈습니다.
cards.english_desc: A traditional nakhwa display was held in Yeoju, Gyeonggi Province. Sparks cascaded from hanging bundles like a waterfall, lighting up the festival night.
cards.hook: When falling sparks turn a festival into a starry show.

cards.english_title: Woman Killed by Falling Transformer Part
cards.korean_desc: 창원의 한 공장 건물에서 60kg짜리 변압기 방열기가 떨어졌습니다. 퇴근하던 40대 여성이 사고를 당해 숨졌습니다.
cards.english_desc: A 60-kilogram transformer radiator fell from a factory building in Changwon. A woman in her 40s was killed in the accident while leaving work.
cards.hook: A routine departure took a shocking turn.

cards.korean_title: 오송 뷰티 엑스포, 수출 계약 1억 달러
cards.english_title: Osong Beauty Expo Wins Nearly $100 Million
cards.korean_desc: 충북 청주의 오송 뷰티 엑스포가 3일 동안 열렸습니다. 행사에서는 약 1억 달러 규모의 수출 계약이 성사됐습니다.
cards.english_desc: The Osong Beauty Expo in Cheongju, North Chungcheong Province, ran for three days. Export contracts worth nearly $100 million were signed at the event.
cards.hook: Beauty products just put nearly $100 million on the table.

cards.english_title: Posco’s 1% Supports Communities
cards.korean_desc: 포스코의 1% 나눔 재단이 부상한 참전용사에게 첨단 의족을 지원합니다. 학생들에게는 직접 참여하는 과학 교육도 제공합니다.
cards.english_desc: Posco’s 1% Sharing Foundation provides advanced prosthetic legs to injured veterans. It also offers hands-on science education to students.
cards.hook: One percent can make a surprisingly big difference.

cards.english_title: Mercedes-Benz Korea Marks 20 Years of Training
cards.korean_desc: 메르세데스-벤츠 코리아가 자동차 정비사 교육 프로그램 20주년을 맞았습니다. 이 프로그램은 전기차 정비 수요에 맞춰 2022년 새롭게 바뀌었습니다.
cards.english_desc: Mercedes-Benz Korea marked the 20th anniversary of its automotive technician training program. The program was revamped in 2022 to meet demand for electric vehicle maintenance.
cards.hook: Twenty years of training, now with an electric twist.

cards.english_title: AIA Life Korea draws 7,000 to K-pop concert
cards.korean_desc: AIA생명은 경기도 고양에서 K팝 콘서트를 열어 약 7,000명을 모았습니다. 말레이시아, 필리핀, 싱가포르 고객과 직원도 참석했습니다.
cards.english_desc: AIA Life Korea held a K-pop concert in Goyang, attracting about 7,000 people. Customers and employees from Malaysia, the Philippines and Singapore also attended.
cards.hook: This concert had customers, partners, and plenty of fan energy.

cards.english_title: A 400-Meter Fried Chicken Feast
cards.korean_desc: 서울 잠수교에서 400m 길이의 식탁을 놓고 치킨 축제가 열렸습니다. 잠수교는 다음 날부터 보행자 전용 공간으로 바뀌기 시작했습니다.
cards.english_desc: A fried chicken festival was held at a 400-meter-long table on Seoul’s Jamsu Bridge. The bridge began changing into a pedestrian-only space the next day.
cards.hook: How much chicken fits on one bridge? Apparently, plenty.

cards.english_title: Korea projects artistic soft power in London
cards.korean_desc: 한국의 문화와 예술 상품이 영국에서 큰 인기를 얻고 있습니다. K팝, 영화, 게임, 음식과 뷰티 제품이 영국 시장에 자리 잡았습니다.
cards.english_desc: South Korean cultural and artistic products are highly popular in Britain. K-pop, films, games, food and beauty products have become established in the UK market.
cards.hook: Korea’s cultural wave is still making stylish ripples in London.

cards.english_title: Cruise visitors to Korea near 1.3 million
cards.korean_desc: 올해 1월부터 8월까지 크루즈선을 타고 한국에 온 외국인이 128만 명에 달했습니다. 중국인 관광객이 증가를 이끌었습니다.
cards.english_desc: From January through August, 1.28 million foreigners arrived in Korea by cruise ship. Chinese visitors drove much of the increase.
cards.hook: Korea’s visitor count is sailing toward a major milestone.

cards.english_title: Jinyoung makes the case for reading slowly
cards.korean_desc: 가수 진영은 아이돌이 된 뒤 책을 읽기 시작했습니다. 그는 천천히 읽는 일이 반복되는 생활 속에서 마음을 깨우는 데 도움이 됐다고 말합니다.
cards.english_desc: Singer Jinyoung began reading after becoming an idol. He says reading slowly helped awaken his mind amid a repetitive life.
cards.hook: Could slowing down be the fastest way to refresh your mind?

cards.korean_title: 삼성 라이온즈 베테랑, 후배에 무대 양보
cards.english_title: Lions Veteran Shares the Spotlight
cards.korean_desc: 42세의 최형우는 정규 시즌에 뛰어난 타격을 보여 주었습니다. 하지만 그는 젊은 동료들이 더 주목받도록 무대를 양보할 뜻을 보였습니다.
cards.english_desc: At 42, Choi Hyoung-woo showed excellent hitting during the regular season. However, he indicated that he was willing to share the spotlight with younger teammates.
cards.hook: Sometimes the veteran’s best play is sharing the stage.

cards.english_title: Two Koreans Finish Second at LPGA Event
cards.korean_desc: 한국에서 열린 LPGA 대회에서 한국 선수 두 명이 공동 2위를 차지했습니다. 일본의 요시다 유리가 우승했고, 한 선수는 4타 차 리드를 지키지 못했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Two South Korean players tied for second at an LPGA event held in Korea. Japan’s Yuri Yoshida won, while one player could not hold a four-stroke lead.
cards.hook: Home soil, close calls, and one Japanese winner.
cards.korean_hook: 홈 코스의 아쉬움, 일본 선수의 우승

cards.english_title: South Korea Wins 29 Para Games Golds
cards.korean_desc: 한국은 2026 아이치·나고야 장애인아시안게임에서 금메달 29개를 따내며 목표를 넘었습니다. 전체 메달 100개로 종합 5위를 기록했습니다.
cards.english_desc: South Korea surpassed its goal at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Para Games by winning 29 gold medals. It finished fifth overall with 100 medals in total.
cards.hook: They aimed for 21 golds, then collected 29.

cards.english_title: Volkanovski Wins Quickly and Keeps His Title
cards.korean_desc: 알렉산더 볼카노프스키가 2라운드 TKO로 에블로예프를 꺾고 UFC 페더급 타이틀을 지켰습니다. 그는 상대의 20연승을 끝내고 아내와의 약속도 지켰습니다.
cards.english_desc: Alexander Volkanovski defeated Evloev by second-round technical knockout and retained his UFC featherweight title. He ended his opponent’s 20-fight winning streak and kept a promise to his wife.
cards.hook: A promise, a quick finish, and a title still held.

cards.english_title: Hanroro to Hold First Arena Concerts
cards.korean_desc: 가수 한로로가 2027년 1월 인천 인스파이어 아레나에서 첫 아레나 공연을 엽니다. 공연은 1월 2일과 3일에 열리며, 최근 차트 성공으로 관심이 커지고 있습니다.
cards.english_desc: Singer Hanroro will hold her first arena concerts at Inspire Arena in Incheon in January 2027. The concerts will take place on January 2 and 3, as interest grows after her recent chart successes.
cards.hook: Her next question mark is written in arena lights.

cards.english_title: Santos Bravos announces first-anniversary release
cards.korean_desc: 라틴 팝 그룹 산토스 브라보스가 데뷔 1주년을 맞아 11월 20일 새 음원을 발표합니다. 이번 음원은 그룹의 첫 기념일 발매입니다.
cards.english_desc: Latin pop group Santos Bravos will release new music on November 20 for its first anniversary. It will be the group’s first anniversary release.
cards.hook: One year old, and Santos Bravos already has birthday music.

cards.korean_title: TWS, 두 번째 싱글로 팬들을 밝힌다
cards.english_title: TWS to light up fans with second single
cards.korean_desc: TWS가 두 번째 싱글 ‘To Us’를 11월 2일 발표합니다. 앨범에는 팬들이 즐길 수 있는 조명 패키지도 포함됩니다.
cards.english_desc: TWS will release its second single, “To Us,” on November 2. The album includes a lighting package for fans to enjoy.
cards.hook: TWS is putting a little glow inside the album.

cards.english_title: I-dle’s Minnie teases solo EP
cards.korean_desc: 아이들의 민니가 솔로 디지털 EP의 음원 일부를 공개했습니다. EP에는 서로 다른 감정을 담은 세 곡이 들어갑니다.
cards.english_desc: I-dle’s Minnie released snippets from her solo digital EP. The EP will contain three songs expressing different emotions.
cards.hook: Minnie offers three emotional clues before the full moon rises.
cards.korean_hook: 민니가 세 가지 감정을 살짝 공개

cards.english_title: California officials frustrated by ballot demand
cards.korean_desc: 미 법무부가 비시민권자에게 보내졌다고 판단한 투표용지를 따로 보관하라고 요구했습니다. 캘리포니아 선거관리자들은 혼란과 불만을 나타냈습니다.
cards.english_desc: The US Justice Department demanded that ballots it believes went to noncitizens be set aside. California election officials expressed confusion and frustration.
cards.hook: A ballot box dispute is rattling California’s election workers.

cards.english_title: Israeli forces displace Hebron families after attack
cards.korean_desc: 이스라엘군이 공격 다음 날 요르단강 서안 헤브론에서 약 2,000명의 주민을 대피시켰습니다. 팔레스타인 자치정부는 국제사회의 압박을 요구했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Israeli forces displaced about 2,000 residents in Hebron in the West Bank after an attack. The Palestinian Authority called for international pressure.
cards.hook: A deadly attack was followed by a mass evacuation.

cards.english_title: Obama attacks Trump allies’ campaign conduct
cards.korean_desc: 버락 오바마 전 대통령이 트럼프 대통령과 공화당 동맹의 잔혹함과 부적절한 행동을 비판했습니다. 그는 오하이오에서 민주당 유권자들을 독려했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Former President Barack Obama criticized what he called cruelty and indecency by President Trump and Republican allies. He rallied Democratic voters in Ohio.
cards.hook: Obama stepped into a campaign fight already running hot.

cards.english_title: Ukraine says Starshield restored, Musk disputes terms
cards.korean_desc: 우크라이나는 스타링크와 군사용 스타실드가 정상적으로 작동한다고 밝혔습니다. 그러나 일론 머스크는 우크라이나군이 회사 약관을 위반했다고 주장했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Ukraine said Starlink and military Starshield were fully functional again. Elon Musk, however, claimed that Ukraine’s military had violated the company’s terms.
cards.hook: The signal returned, but the argument stayed online.
